title: Mathematics Basics
tagline: Algebra, geometry and problem solving from absolute zero.
description: A friendly, step-by-step introduction to the core ideas of mathematics. You'll build real confidence with numbers, equations and shapes through short, focused video lessons and worked examples.

lessons.title: Numbers & Operations
lessons.description: Whole numbers, fractions and the order of operations.

lessons.title: Introduction to Algebra
lessons.description: What variables are and how to solve simple equations.

lessons.title: Geometry Fundamentals
lessons.description: Angles, triangles and the area of common shapes.

title: Python for Beginners
tagline: Write your first programs with the world's friendliest language.
description: Learn Python from scratch — variables, loops, functions and small projects. Perfect if you've never programmed before, and a great way to start a career in tech.

lessons.title: What is Programming?
lessons.description: How computers follow instructions and what code looks like.

lessons.title: Variables & Data Types
lessons.description: Storing information with variables, numbers, text and booleans.

lessons.title: Loops & Conditions
lessons.description: Making decisions with if/else and repeating work with loops.

title: English Grammar Essentials
tagline: Master tenses, articles and sentence structure with confidence.
description: A clear, practical guide to English grammar for learners at every level. Understand how sentences work and communicate more clearly in writing and speech.

lessons.title: Parts of Speech
lessons.description: Nouns, verbs, adjectives and how sentences are built.

lessons.title: Verb Tenses
lessons.description: Past, present and future — and when to use each one.

lessons.title: Articles & Prepositions
lessons.description: Master a, an, the, and the little words that connect ideas.
